title: Extract seal boundary closed, and open findings made visible in canonical current state
attempt_outcome: COMPLETE — F-MD-B00-A001-003 closed by remediation; two synchronization defects found and fixed; MD-B00 remains DONE with a successor closure manifest

runtime_artifact_boundary.classification: Document-corpus and tooling proof under section 5 of RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_AND_GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_STANDARD.md.
runtime_artifact_boundary.basis: The invariants are structural properties of governed document records and of the generated current-state summary. No runtime artifact is required or claimed.

baseline.basis_for_reentry: MD-B01 and MD-B03 are both held by governance decisions with no implementation remediation path. MD-B00 closed with F-MD-B00-A001-003 declared deferred rather than fixed, and its remediation was already specified in the finding. MD-B00-A002 set the precedent for re-entering a DONE stage and issuing a successor closure manifest without editing the prior one.

defect_1_extract_seal_boundary.defect: LEGACY_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_INTEGRITY hashes only the region between LEGACY_EXTRACT_BODY_START and LEGACY_EXTRACT_BODY_END. Text appended after the body-end marker was covered by nothing, so an unsealed paragraph could be added to a HISTORICAL_ONLY extract and pass every gate — precisely the rewrite DOCUMENT_RECORDING_STANDARD.md forbids.

reproduced_before_fixing.why: A finding that describes a gap is not the same as a gap that still exists, and the finding was raised two attempts earlier.
reproduced_before_fixing.method_note: The first reproduction attempt read the gate's process exit code and was contaminated: the gate was already exiting 1 because this attempt's own baseline lock was not yet registered. The exit code said 1 for a reason unrelated to the mutation. The check status was isolated and read directly instead.

fix.form: A structural assertion, as the finding prescribed — not a wider hash. Extending the hash would break the reconstruction proof, which must stay bound to the exact original source range so the 43-source reconstruction remains meaningful.
asserts: nothing but an optional single newline after the body-end marker
the file still opens with its `# Legacy Semantic Extract` header — the positive locator, so a file that lost both markers and its header cannot pass by having nothing left to check
fix.scope: 428 extracts, every one the split index references, across records/history/archive/semantic (294), records/evidence/legacy/semantic (100), and records/decisions/legacy (34). The finding's own measurement covered only the first directory.
fix.vacuity_floor: The check fails if the scan reaches fewer than 400 extracts. The risk the finding names is an unsealed edit passing silently; a scan that silently reached nothing would reproduce that risk somewhere new.

defect_1_extract_seal_boundary.reconstruction_proof_untouched: LEGACY_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_INTEGRITY still reports 43 split sources, 43 reconstructed, 0 errors.

defect_2_open_findings_invisible.found_while: confirming the current state before opening the attempt
defect_2_open_findings_invisible.defect: GenerateMarketDataCurrentState.php reported findings from the current stage's register row alone, so a finding owned by any other stage never reached CURRENT_STATE.md. Section 20 of the execution contract requires canonical current state to stay synchronized.
invisible_findings: F-MD-B03-A003-001 — OPEN, raised in the immediately preceding attempt and invisible the moment it was written
defect_2_open_findings_invisible.fix: The generator now reads the findings corpus and emits every finding that is not CLOSED, RESOLVED, or SUPERSEDED, with its status. CURRENT_STATE.md went from naming 2 findings to naming all of them.
defect_2_open_findings_invisible.count_after_fix: 7 open at first regeneration, 6 after F-MD-B00-A001-003 closed in this attempt

defect_3_lifecycle_field_inconsistency.defect: Finding records use two lifecycle field names. Most write `- Status:`; F-MD-20260821-03 writes `- State:`. A reader scanning one name silently gets an incomplete corpus.
defect_3_lifecycle_field_inconsistency.fix: The reader accepts both. F-MD-20260821-03 is registered LIFECYCLE_UPDATE_ONLY, so the record was not restructured to suit a reader — the reader was made to handle the corpus as it is.
defect_3_lifecycle_field_inconsistency.safeguard: An unreadable lifecycle is treated as open. A status nobody can parse is not evidence of closure.

changed: development/implementation/tests/GenerateMarketDataCurrentState.php — open findings derived from the corpus rather than from one register row
added: tests/Unit/MarketData/FindingRecordConsistencyTest.php — fails when a finding's lifecycle is unreadable or an open finding is missing from the generated current state, which catches a stale CURRENT_STATE.md rather than trusting it

test_execution.runner: vendor/bin/phpunit and the documentation integrity gate directly
test_execution.note: 1677 before this attempt plus the 3 added here.

negative_and_fail_closed_proof.method: Every mutation asserted to have landed before the guard was judged, and every probe against a sealed record restored from a pre-mutation copy with the restoration verified by re-running the check.
mutations: text appended after the sealed body of a real extract -> LEGACY_EXTRACT_STRUCTURE failed (landed, 26 bytes); this is the finding's exact case, which passed before the fix
a duplicated LEGACY_EXTRACT_BODY_END marker -> LEGACY_EXTRACT_STRUCTURE failed (landed)
the `# Legacy Semantic Extract` header renamed -> LEGACY_EXTRACT_STRUCTURE failed (landed, count=1)
an open finding removed from CURRENT_STATE.md -> FindingRecordConsistencyTest failed (landed, count=1)
a finding's `- Status:` line replaced with an unrecognised field -> lifecycle-readability guard failed (landed, count=1)
negative_and_fail_closed_proof.restoration_verified: All five restored; LEGACY_EXTRACT_STRUCTURE returns PASS over 428 extracts and the suite is green.
